title: Show authorized inventory-aging evidence distribution by warehouse and status
description: An inventory user groups the currently authorized dynamic stock-aging page by warehouse, aging-evidence status or cost-evidence status and sees a visual count distribution. Reuse ERP-135 stock-query permission, bounded preview and selected filters. Count rows only; do not sum different product/base-unit quantities, turn unknown cost into zero, infer age buckets, or recompute valuation. Invalid group keys fail closed and HTTP audit records read-only requests. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit and Node logic tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts only none/warehouse/ageEvidence/costEvidence grouping and returns deterministic row counts from the same authorized preview page without summing incompatible units or unknown amounts.
Designer renders labeled page-only count distribution for warehouse and known/partial/unknown evidence, including empty pages and pagination changes.
Unit and Node tests cover group keys, warehouse splits, missing evidence, empty page, permission and safe chart text; document evidence and page-only count semantics.
